# Artem Letyushev — Technical Project Manager

> Owner-maintained portfolio. Claims are self-reported; preserve estimates and forecasts as such. Translations are not independent verification.

Updated: 2026-11-04

7+ years in tech. Led delivery for 5 teams, around 50 people. Fintech, telecom and dating services.

## Selected outcomes

- Twinby · Fraudulent users (2.5× fewer): Reduced the number of fraudulent users 2.5× as Product Owner by launching a nine-service antifraud platform. Estimated impact: $800K per year.
- Twinby · Task lead time (64 → 16 days): Cut lead time from 64 to 16 days by building a backend team, introducing engineering standards and establishing regular releases.
- Fintech · User retention (+15%): Led five teams launching apps in Mexico, India and Nigeria. Retention rose 15%; conversion from registration to deposit increased 10%.
- Fintech · Release interval (−20%): Reduced the interval between releases by 20% by automating release preparation and changing the development process across a five-team unit.
- MTS · Quarterly plan delivery (+15%): Improved delivery against quarterly plans by 15% by aligning priorities and dependencies across teams and adjacent business streams.
- MTS · Time to market (2 → 1.5 months): Reduced time to market from 2 to 1.5 months by restructuring joint planning and coordinating dependencies between teams.
